name: All-in-Focus Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A framework to synthesize all-in-focus (AiF) novel views from dual-camera image pairs (main and ultra-wide) where the main camera has consistent defocus blur due to fixed autofocus on a prominent object.
summary: All-in-Focus Neural Radiance Fields synthesizes sharp novel views from dual-camera pairs by fusing high-resolution main camera details with sharp ultra-wide references to overcome defocus blur.
